summary.headline: Trace-driven three-stage WAN simulation projects 12.63 committed tok/s at 60 ms RTT with K=1, W=8; 1.20× the strongest synchronous speculative control, 36.3% of the best zero-WAN throughput. WAN wait is 11.6% and discarded target compute is 74.0%.
